products.name: Oracle C2M Performance Tuning & Resource Optimization — Commercial
products.short_description: A measure-first C2M performance tuning method — JVM/GC, WebLogic pools, batch, and SQL — that turns a slow environment into a measured, optimized one, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Make C2M fast — JVM, WebLogic, batch, and database

As C2M load grows, performance problems surface across the stack — JVM/GC, WebLogic thread pools and connection pools, batch throughput, and database. This solution provides a measure-first tuning method for C2M and its WebLogic 14c middleware: find the real bottleneck and tune JVM/GC, server and data-source pools, batch, and SQL — turning a slow environment into a measured, optimized one, pilot-first.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the C2M performance model (JVM/GC → WebLogic pools → batch → database) and the measure-first tuning method.
  • Requirements Guide — what you need to tune (metrics/monitoring, environment access, workload profile) with how to verify each.
  • Tuning Method — ordered steps: measure and baseline, isolate the bottleneck, tune JVM/GC, WebLogic thread/connection pools, batch threadpools, and SQL/database, then re-measure and validate the gain, pilot-first.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with measured pass/fail gates plus Best Practices for repeatable, evidence-based tuning.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A slow C2M environment turned into a measured, optimized one — JVM, pools, batch, and SQL tuned to the real bottleneck — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 6 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OC2MPERF-Discovery.py — read-only baseline of the C2M / WebLogic 14c performance stack
    • OC2MPERF-Remediation.py — apply ONE validated WebLogic tuning change (DRY-RUN by default)
    • OC2MPERF-Report.sh — read-only health/coverage evidence pack for C2M performance tuning
    • OC2MPERF-Report.sql — read-only Oracle Database performance snapshot for C2M tuning
    • OC2MPERF-ScopeHelper.sh — record the tuning pilot scope and rollback targets
    • OC2MPERF-Validation.py — read-only re-measure of the C2M / WebLogic 14c stack after a change

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
